observational_status: three matched native M3D-C1 dt levels; no experimental shot, calibrated current integral, validated equilibrium/profile handoff or segmented controller-in-loop
successful_milestone: Twelve native M3D-C1 runs completed (556.13 s) with exact zero-source equivalence at all three dt levels on a matched 1004-element mesh. Full-field three-level difference ratios expose nonmonotonic numerical sensitivity and falsify an unwarranted convergence promotion.
interpretation: Opposite-signed jphi source responses persist, but fieldwise convergence remains unestablished: at t=0.03 negative medium/fine difference is 142.19% of fine field norm and positive is 38.47%. Both successive-difference ratios at t=0.03 are below one (0.829 and 0.731), meaning finer-step differences grew rather than shrank. Odd-symmetry residual at t=0.03 changes 35.94% -> 3.11% -> 34.35%; aggregate symmetry is not reliable evidence of convergence.
followup_scope: One fixed-dt (0.000625) native M3D-C1 two-repeat audit of baseline, same-mode zero, +/-0.005 commands, comparing raw and response fields at t=0.01/0.02/0.03 to isolate run-to-run repeatability from timestep sensitivity without changing solver physics.
handoff_equivalence: unvalidated; same-mode zero-source equivalence is not experimental shot handoff
pb11_fidelity_limits: not_applicable; no p-B11 reaction, recirculation, radiation/electron loss, alpha transport/channeling, boron delivery, direct conversion, rotating plasma, rotation/shear, liquid lithium, ignition margin or net-power evidence
m3dc1_claim_boundary: Three-level fieldwise temporal sensitivity of normalized-native M3D-C1 jphi source response only; e[2] uncalibrated. No physical current conservation, segmented-electrode authority, experimental shot handoff, causal TCT stabilization, p-B11 fidelity or reactor-net-power claim.
